item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Somewhere in that packed schedule, doses can slide when the day gets loud. You've got structure around meditation, walks, and wind-down tonight, but nothing on the list explicitly protects medication timing. Build the habit: attach each dose to something you're already doing, morning routine, dinner, bedtime, so it rides along instead of competing for attention. Action: set one alarm right now for your next dose.
